glosses: varying with; from one … to the next
patterns.usage_note: Names case-to-case variation: the noun names a set of cases and the predicate reports difference or inconsistency (人によって違う, 天候によって見えたり見えなかったり). That predicate of difference is the diagnostic; without one the same form reads as its siblings, means or cause or passive agent (地震によって), or conformity to a rule (規則によって). によっては, casually によっちゃ, is the topic-marked shape and carries only this reading.

examples.ruby: 好[この]みは人[ひと]によって大[おお]きく違[ちが]うものだ。
examples.english: Tastes vary widely from person to person.

examples.ruby: 地方[ちほう]によって同[おな]じ料理[りょうり]の味付[あじつ]けが違[ちが]う。
examples.english: The same dish is seasoned differently from one region to the next.

examples.ruby: 曜日[ようび]によって図書館[としょかん]の閉[し]まる時間[じかん]が変[か]わる。
examples.english: The library's closing time changes depending on the day of the week.
